questions_and_answers.question_text: In German, the preposition 'vor' with a dative phrase referring to an extent of time means:

answers.answer: Ich fuhr vor zwei Wochen zur Segelregatta
Vor dem Haus steht ein Auto
Sie war vor dem Essen fertig

questions_and_answers.question_text: The sentence 'Vor zehn Jahren war der Verkehr auf den Strassen nicht so stark wie jetzt' translates to:

answers.answer: Ten years ago the traffic was not as heavy as now
In ten years traffic will not be heavy
Traffic before ten years was heavy
Ten years before the traffic will not be heavy

questions_and_answers.question_text: What does 'Ich habe sie vor einigen Tagen gesehen' mean?

answers.answer: I saw her a few days ago
I will see her in a few days
I saw her before a few days
She saw me a few days ago

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which of the following phrases shows 'vor' used with time?
What is the function of the dative phrase following 'vor'?

answers.answer: Indicates the length of time that has passed

questions_and_answers.question_text: The sentence 'Vor einer Stunde sass er bei mir im Büro' indicates that:

answers.answer: He was sitting with me an hour ago
He will sit with me in an hour
He sits with me for an hour
He sits in my office for an hour

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which preposition is used to mean 'ago' in these examples?
True or False: The preposition 'vor' meaning 'ago' only appears with singular nouns.

articles.text:
The preposition vor "ago"
We have already encountered the preposition vor meaning "before".
In this unit it occurs with a new meaning:
Ich fuhr vor zwei Wochen zur Segelregatta.
Two weeks ago I went to the sailing regatta.
Vor plus a dative phrase referring to extent of time has the meaning "ago".
Note these additional examples:
Vor zehn Jahren war der Verkehr auf den Strassen nicht so stark wie jetzt.
Vor einer Stunde sass er bei mir im Büro.
Ich habe sie vor einigen Tagen gesehen.
Ten years ago the traffic in the streets was not as heavy as it is now.
An hour ago he was sitting with me in my office.
I saw her a few days ago.
